description: This file contains unit tests for the CurrentDateTimeAPI class within the OrangeHRM Attendance plugin. It tests the 'getOne' API endpoint and verifies that other methods such as update, delete, and validation rule retrieval are not implemented and correctly raise exceptions.

classes.name: CurrentDateTimeAPITest
classes.description: A test class extending EndpointIntegrationTestCase, focusing on testing the CurrentDateTimeAPI's 'getOne' endpoint and ensuring other methods throw not implemented exceptions.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the 'getOne' API call with different test cases provided by the data provider.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for 'testGetOne' method, loading data from a YAML file.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Verifies that calling 'update' on the API throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Verifies that retrieving validation rules for update throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that calling 'delete' on the API throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that retrieving validation rules for delete throws a not implemented exception.
